name: Feminist Artificial Intelligence Gender Bias Evaluation Framework (FemAI-DEC)
description: This study addresses the problem of algorithmic gender bias, which has become increasingly visible in artificial intelligence systems, and presents a feminist audit framework for this problem. Aiming to strengthen the interaction between technical audit mechanisms and feminist theoretical frameworks, this research has developed the Feminist Artificial Intelligence Gender Bias Evaluation Framework (FemAI-DEC), which brings theoretical knowledge together with an applicable evaluation practice. Structured in light of feminist theoretical approaches, this model includes four main dimensions: Data Justice, Design and Participation, Output Analysis, and Accountability and Transparency. This framework has been made available in a digital environment through an interactive scoring system in order to enable the systematic auditing of AI systems, make ethical risks measurable, and increase transparency. This digital tool, as a conceptual development study, aims to provide a concrete contribution to both academic discussions and the development of inclusive AI policies with its accessible structure that does not require technical expertise.
